title: Car on Curve MicroSim
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating centripetal force and friction requirements for a car navigating a curve. Shows the relationship between speed, curve radius, and coefficient of friction to determine safe driving conditions.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: centripetal force
friction
circular motion
physics
dynamics
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of car on curve
Explore car on curve through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of car on curve to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on car on curve
